title: Cut-off affine homotopies on ℝ^{P+1}: global Lipschitz bound, uniformly Lipschitz C¹ approximations, and the pulled-back integrand
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ. Write pr(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) ∈ ℝ^P (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp y))) and y₀ := WithLp.ofLp y 0 for y ∈ ℝ^{P+1}, ι(t,x) := (t, x) (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) and ê₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1. Let Λ, L_a, L_χ ∈ ℝ≥0 and A ∈ ℝ. Let F, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be Λ-Lipschitz, a : ℝ → ℝ L_a-Lipschitz with |a| ≤ A, and χ : ℝ^P → ℝ L_χ-Lipschitz with compact support. For maps Φ, Ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P put H_{Φ,Ψ}(y) := Φ(pr y) + (a(y₀)·χ(pr y))•(Ψ(pr y) − Φ(pr y)). Then three statements hold. (A) H_{F,G} is Lipschitz. (B) Suppose a and χ are C¹, and F_j, G_j are C¹ Λ-Lipschitz maps with F_j → F and G_j → G uniformly. Then every H_{F_j,G_j} is C¹, all H_{F_j,G_j} are L-Lipschitz for one L, and H_{F_j,G_j} → H_{F,G} uniformly on ℝ^{P+1}. (C) Suppose a, χ, F', G' are C¹, W ⊆ ℝ^P is open with χ = 1 on W, and a(s) = s for s ∈ (−1, 2). Let x ∈ W, t ∈ (−1, 2), k ∈ ℕ and ω a (k+1)-form, and put H' := H_{F',G'}. Then (((ω(H'(ι(t,x)))) ∘ DH'(ι(t,x))).curryLeft ê₀) ∘ D_xι(t,x) = (ω(F'x + t(G'x − F'x)).curryLeft (G'x − F'x)) ∘ (DF'(x) + t(DG'(x) − DF'(x))), where D_xι(t,x) = fderiv ℝ (x' ↦ ι(t,x')) x.
